entries.title: Singnagtugaq (A Greenlander's Dream)Mathias Storch
entries.rationale: work:7757 Singnagtugaq (A Greenlander's Dream). UQAM and Volquardsen establish Storch’s foundational challenge to colonial inequality, while noting a modernization ideal later writers contested. Orthofer finds value beyond history but blunt construction. Keep first for historical standing and its compact, translated entry point; foundational status does not make it an uncontested model of Greenlandic literary identity. Evidence: R20260927-RG002, R20260927-RG003, R20260927-RG004, S1375, S1378.
